name: MDURATION
description: MDURATION returns the modified Macaulay duration, which measures the percentage price change of a bond for a 1% change in yield.
tldr: Calculates the modified duration of a bond.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.explanation: For a 5% coupon bond yielding 6% with semi-annual payments, this returns the modified duration.

advancedExamples.title: Estimate price sensitivity
advancedExamples.description: If MDURATION is 7.5, a 1% yield increase causes roughly a 7.5% price drop.
advancedExamples.explanation: Basis 1 is used for Treasury bonds.

howItWorks: MDURATION adjusts Macaulay duration for yield to measure price sensitivity. Modified duration = Macaulay duration / (1 + yld/frequency).

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Modified duration is a linear approximation; convexity improves accuracy for large yield changes.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: MDURATION works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between DURATION and MDURATION?
faq.answer: DURATION is Macaulay duration. MDURATION is modified duration, which measures price sensitivity directly.

faq.question: How do I use MDURATION to estimate price change?
faq.answer: Approximate percentage price change = -MDURATION * yield change.
